verdict.rationale: Unity's core editor and player install and run on the user's own machines. The docs show headless/batch operation, a standalone CLI for installing editors on your own CI build agents, and keyless Hub/CLI install paths (unity-docs-8, unity-docs-25, unity-docs-26, unity-probe-rt-3, unity-probe-rt-4). However, it is proprietary and plan-licensed, a community report says the editor depends on phoning home, and the evidence shows no way to self-host the cloud parts: AI is metered via Unity Credits and builds run through Unity Build Automation. Missing for 10: documented offline or air-gapped operation, self-hostable versions of the cloud services (AI, Build Automation), and open or source-available core code.
